visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a square stainless steel pot on a gas stove, where food is vigorously frying in hot, bubbling oil. A pair of wooden chopsticks stirs the items. Dark grey tiles form the background wall. Large yellow subtitles appear at the bottom center of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a man wearing a black t-shirt and a watch, sitting at a wooden dining table in a brightly lit indoor room. He uses blue chopsticks to pick up and eat fried food from several diverse plates containing fries, chicken, and squid. The background shows a white door and home appliances. (3) In a kitchen setting, a person's hands are shown preparing sweet potato fries. They pour egg liquid from a metal cup into a stainless steel bowl filled with orange sweet potato strips. A red-strapped smart band is visible on the wrist. White text overlays describe the process of adding ingredients. (4) The cooking continues as a gloved hand adds sugar from a jar and flour from a plastic bag into the bowl, thoroughly mixing the sweet potatoes. The lighting is bright and indoor. The square frying pot sits empty in the background on the stovetop. (5) The oil preparation phase begins. Water droplets are flicked into the hot pot to test for non-stick readiness, followed by oil being poured from a glass bottle. Chopsticks are inserted to check for bubbles, signaling the correct temperature. The camera is static and at a close-up distance. (6) The frying process is shown in detail. Sweet potato fries, chicken nuggets, and marinated squid are fried in separate stages. The person uses a large circular wire strainer to scoop out the golden-brown finished products. Bubbling oil and steam are visually prominent throughout the sequence. (7) The final phase features a slow panning shot over the dining table, displaying the complete fried platter including dumplings, fish, and greens. The lighting is warm and domestic. A long white text box at the bottom provides a health tip regarding the use of stainless steel utensils.
